info.name: TAVLA — Platform Back Office (Phase 19.1, standalone fragment)
info.description:
Standalone Postman fragment for Phase 19.1 — Platform Back Office Foundation (ADR-034 subset, ADR-035 tenancy patterns).

**Not yet merged into the main TAVLA API collection** — import this alongside it. Reuses the main collection's `{{baseUrl}}` and `{{platformAdminAccessToken}}` conventions.

**Scope**: Platform Roles/RBAC (PlatformAdmin/PlatformSupport), Platform Admin account CRUD, Restaurant lifecycle (Suspend/Reactivate/Delete/Restore), Organization lifecycle (Suspend/Reactivate/Emergency Ownership Transfer), Account access control (Force Logout/Reset Credentials/Disable/Enable Login).

**Out of scope this fragment**: ADR-033 (Customer Acquisition/Pricing/Revenue), Platform Dashboard, Audit Log Read API, Platform Search, Organization Delete/Restore, Notification delivery aggregation — none implemented this phase.

All routes: `{{baseUrl}}/platform-admin/...`, guarded by `PlatformAdminGuard` + `PlatformAdminRoleGuard`. Every mutation requires the `PlatformAdmin` tier; `PlatformSupport` is read-only.

request.description:
## Purpose
Create a Platform Admin or Platform Support account (PlatformAdmin only). Mirrors Restaurant Owner provisioning's trust model — no OTP, the supplied password is final.
## Authorization
Bearer `{{platformAdminAccessToken}}` (Platform Admin issuer).
Guards: PlatformAdminGuard, PlatformAdminRoleGuard
## Required Role
PlatformAdmin (PlatformSupport denied)
## Headers
- `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
- `Content-Type: application/json`
## Success Response
Envelope message: "Platform Admin account created successfully."
## Error Responses
- 403 FORBIDDEN if caller is not an active Platform Admin (or wrong tier)
- 404 NOT_FOUND for an unknown/cross-tenant id (IDOR-safe)
## Notes
- Phase 19.1 (ADR-034 subset). See docs/DECISIONS.md ADR-034/ADR-035.
